summary: Minor or disabled children, a disabled spouse and disabled parents are guaranteed half of their intestate share. Russia has no trust law and is outside the Hague Trusts Convention. Choice of foreign law is unconfirmed.
reserved_share: Minor or disabled children, disabled spouse and parents, and disabled dependants: not less than 1/2 of the intestate share; Civil Code art. 1149.
foreign_law_note: Civil Code art. 1224 applies the law of the deceased's last domicile (law of location for registered immovables); whether the testator may choose a national law was not confirmed.
trust_note: Only trust management of property (a contract) exists, not a trust. Non-commercial foundations (Civil Code art. 123.17) exist; recent statutes on personal or private foundations were not verified.
open_questions: Art. 1224 conflict rule and any choice of law.
Whether Russia has introduced private or personal foundations since 2022.
Sanctions and capital controls on cross-border estates.
